headline: Crude Oil Slumps Over 3% as Middle East Flows and Libyan Pipeline Resume
summary: Brent crude tumbled 3.51% to $89.32 a barrel and WTI fell 3.56% to $85.34 as rising Middle East supply and the restart of a Libyan pipeline eased regional supply disruption concerns.
why: Oil benchmark prices dictate input costs globally and heavily influence inflation dynamics and sovereign revenues across major exporters.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Fell 3.51% as Libyan pipeline flow returned and Middle Eastern export volume expanded.

impacts.name: WTI crude
impacts.why: Dropped 3.56% alongside Brent on loosening global crude supply balances.
